correctness.rationale: At fixed a>0 the source treatment T_b(I)=aI/(b+I) has T_b(0)=0 and derivative a/b for b>0, but its b=0 positive-I branch equals a and the rational expression is undefined at (b,I)=(0,0). At S=S0=A/(mu1+gamma+delta), B=0, I approaching 0 positively, the b=0 full vector field approaches (a,-a,0), so no continuous extension can make the proposed DFE stationary. Defining T_0(0)=0 would instead give a discontinuous vector field; ordinary smooth Jacobian/LaSalle reasoning is unavailable. Independently, source Eq.(3.9) has M(S0,0,0)=(a,0), hence I'=-a at its printed equilibrium. R0 formula collapses to zero at b=0, not a legitimate smooth invasion threshold. Fixed b>0 is not criticized.
